title: Nomu
description: adds Nomu From MHA to minecraft as a hostile mob
body:
adds the character nomu from my hero academia as a hostile mob in minecraft

(currently only supports forge 1.20.1)

(only adds the nomu from season 1)

(Does not spawn naturally, only spawns Via comamnds and spawn eggs)

nomu's powers: immune to explosions, fall damage, drowning, lightning, fire, anvils, estimated to be as fast as a baby zombie 5.1 knockback power 

loot: 1 netherite and 5 xp points

(only hostile to players)

health:1000

species: unidentified

which means neither an arthropod or an undead or a drowned

they say it's "bio-engineered"

4 blocks tall

with insane speed and knockback

"the anti-symbol of peace"

i made this mod to defeat the symbol of peace and u can use it as well, by downloading this mod u can manipulate the anti-symbol of peace into doing pretty much anything one thing is it can still attack you and other players he IS the "anti-symbol of peace" after all
